text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meisho Doto is convinced that with some intensive summer training, winning against the previous generation could become a reality.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But I've noticed her growth stagnating, and I can't quite share her optimism. Can we really break past this ever-looming ceiling?
